verses.1: Moses gathered all the tribes of Israel and said to them, “These are the things that Yahweh has commanded us to do.”
verses.2: Six days shall be employed for working. On the seventh day, it shall be holy for you. This is the Sabbath of Jehovah. All work must be stopped on that day.
verses.3: Do not light a fire in all your dwellings on the Day of Resurrection.
verses.4: And Moses said to all the tribes of Israel, “This is what the LORD has commanded.”
verses.5: Take from yourselves a sacrifice for the Lord. All those who are generous in their hearts will bring the sacrifices of the Lord: gold, silver, and other valuable items.
verses.6: And the vulture, and the eagle, and the second serpent, and the seven, and the wild animals.
verses.7: And there are also cities of sheep, and cities of cattle; and there are also cities of goats.
verses.8: And the smoke for lighting the lamps, and in the heavens for the smoke of burning, and for the incense altar.
verses.9: And the rocks of Shoham and the rocks of Miluim are for destruction and for destruction.
verses.10: And all those who are wise in heart will come and do whatever the Lord commands.
verses.11: I will take the tent, its poles, its frames, its boards, its ropes, and its pegs.
verses.12: The altar and its utensils, the cover, and all the parts of the sanctuary.
verses.13: The tables, and all their utensils, and everything else related to them, as well as the bread that is used for offerings.
verses.14: And the lampstand, and all its parts, and its wicks, and the oil of the lamp.
verses.15: And the altar of the incense, and its utensils, and the oil for the sacrifice, and the censer, and the altar itself.
verses.16: And the idol of the sun, and the statue of the goddess who has all its attributes. The altar and everything related to it.
verses.17: I will remove the doors of the courtyard, its posts, and its lintels. I will also remove the gates of the courtyard.
verses.18: The walls of the house, and the walls of the courtyard, as well as its gates.
verses.19: The garments of the priest for his sacred duties, and the garments of the sacred things for Aaron, the priest, and for his sons as priests.
verses.20: And all the tribes of the Israelites came before Moses.
verses.21: And every man who had a desire to offer sacrifices, and everyone who had something that could be used as an offering, brought their offerings to fill the Temple of God and for all His rituals and sacred ceremonies.
verses.22: And the men came before the women. They were all generous people. They brought gold jewelry, necklaces, bracelets, and all kinds of gold items. Each person who wore these gold items was considered to be worthy of worshiping Yahweh.
verses.23: And every man who found a scribe, a pot, an armory, a second spear, six spears, and wild oxen and sheep from the fields, they brought them forward.
verses.24: All those who were collecting gold and silver brought in their offerings to Jehovah. And everything that was found among them, including wood for all the purposes of labor, they also brought in.
verses.25: And every woman who has wisdom in her hands, she will weave the pattern and bring it together. She will also prepare the tools needed for the second layer of the fabric, as well as the six threads.
verses.26: And all the women who gave birth to sons with wisdom, they were able to defeat the enemies.
verses.27: And those who carried them brought along the stones of the Shoham and the stones of the Milulim, for use in building and as decorations.
verses.28: And the bows and the ropes for the lamps, as well as the ropes used to hold them in place.
verses.29: All men and women who were willing to do these tasks, as commanded by Jehovah, brought their offerings to Him. The children of Israel also brought their offerings to Jehovah.
verses.30: And Moses said to the children of Israel, “See, God is calling out in the name of Bezalel, son of Uri, son of Hur, for the service of the Jewish people.”
verses.31: And He filled him with the breath of God, with wisdom, understanding, and all kinds of knowledge.
verses.32: And consider that thoughts can be carried out through gold, silver, and other precious metals.
verses.33: And in the time of building a house, and in the time of planting trees, one must do everything with careful consideration.
verses.34: And to them, he gave Holohoroth in his heart. And Aholiaab, son of Achisamach, was given as a reward for their efforts.
verses.35: He gives them the wisdom of the heart, so that they can carry out any kind of work, whether it’s simple or complex. They can plan and organize everything in detail, both in terms of structure and organization. They can also create all kinds of tools and devices for various tasks.
